package.name: om6dof_pick_and_place_gemini
package.description: Grasp-from-point-cloud pick-and-place for the 6-DOF OM6DOF, with Google Gemini as the reasoning step. An RGB-D frame from the wrist D405 becomes a point cloud, GraspNet-baseline by default (with an analytic fallback) proposes 6-DoF grasps, the candidates are filtered for gripper width, table clearance, approach angle and IK reachability, and the winner is executed as pregrasp/grasp/lift/place waypoints through MoveGroup. Gemini either names the object that was picked (so it lands in the right bin) or locates a target described in plain text. Port of the ROBOTIS OMY "GraspNet pick and place" technical story onto this arm's MoveIt stack; the OMY original drives a MoveL controller over Zenoh, which this arm does not have.
